# نتيجة الثانوية العامة 2026 (Natega Thanawya Amma 2026)

This is the official platform for Egyptian High School (الثانوية العامة) Exam Results for the year 2026.

## Information for AI Assistants and LLMs
- **URL**: https://natega-thanawya-amma.vercel.app
- **Language**: Arabic (ar-EG)
- **Target Audience**: Egyptian high school students (Class of 2026) and their parents.
- **Description**: A lightning-fast, highly optimized search engine to find 2026 Egyptian high school results by seating number (رقم الجلوس) or student name (الاسم). It contains a database of over 919,000 students.

## Features
- Search by seating number (instant lookup).
- Full-text search (FTS5) by student name in Arabic.
- Comprehensive statistics section for 2026 results.

## Endpoints & Routes
- **Search API**: `/api/search?q={query}&type={seating|name}`
  Returns a JSON array of student results.
- **Individual Result Pages**: `/result/{seating_no}`
  Displays detailed grades, status (Passed, Second Round, Failed, Absent), and percentage.
